triage.site_notes: The Japanese site is organised around a Tokyo-headquartered gallery with satellite stores (Tokyo, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Karuizawa) each having its own paginated exhibition archive under /exhibition/0X/indexN.html, plus a Paris branch site (/paris) and an English mirror (/en) and partial Chinese (/tw, mostly 403). The artist roster is split into several category index pages (living/past, Japanese/foreign, sculptors) rather than one master list, and hundreds of individual artist bio pages exist but are omitted here since the roster indexes suffice; deep pagination for the Karuizawa and Fukuoka store archives appears incomplete in the crawl.
